text: このラーメン、マジでうめーな。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 昨日の試合、最後の逆転がすげえよかった。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: やべー、財布を家に忘れてきた。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: うるせー！今いいところなんだから黙ってろ！

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: いてーな、どこ見て歩いてんだよ。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: こいつ、思ったよりずっとつえーぞ。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 今回のボス、図体でけーくせに動きが速すぎる。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: ちげーよ、そこの箱じゃなくて右の宝箱だって。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 説明書を読んでも全然わかんねー。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: そんな話、俺は知らねえよ。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15
